name: Komae Christoph Yousuke
original_name: 駒江・クリストフ・ヨウスケ
source:
"Until that time comes... we have to fight. That's why we're here."

The member of SRX with the highest score, a battle genius.
He usually acts cool and stoic, but he hides a great passion deep inside.
His parents were LAG researchers who died when he was young, so he was taken in by [url=/c29969]Takuto's[/url] family and they were raised together.
His hobby is cooking and he considers himself the sole member of the cooking club at the base. He has skill, but he's bad at cooking fish.
He plays second guitar for the Odd-I's band.
His partner Substance is [url=/c30010]Fernandes[/url].
